_comment: Editor tooling esp (NOT a shipped product) — built by ModForge itself (dogfood). SCB_MarkerACTI is the visible marker proxy the DLL PlaceObjectAtMe's: model = vanilla summon-circle FX (read from Skyrim.esm 07CD55 via houseCARL, guaranteed-valid path). The DLL looks this up as SceneCaptureTools.esp:0x800 and falls back to the vanilla activator when this esp is absent, so the plugin works without it. Rebuild: dotnet run --project src/ModForge.Cli -- build sub_projs/scene-capture-bridge/tools-spec.json <out>/SceneCaptureTools.esp
